segments.text: Welcome to the park.
We extend our thanks to local businesses
for sponsoring this free concert event.
Be sure to check out their special offers.
The concert will open with an orchestra
performing traditional songs,
and this year is especially exciting
as many school orchestras are joining in.
Following that, there will be a surprise talent performance
which has been praised by critics as a highlight of the show,
leading up to a closing performance
by the local favorite boy band.
While entry is free, seating is limited.
You can reserve tickets online, especially for elderly guests or young children.
A standing area will also be available for those who want to enjoy the rhythm and dance
along.
